**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organization Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day\-to\-day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation, Synchrony's Engineering Team is the place to be.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for development and support of Web based digital applications and delivering high\-quality solutions. The ideal candidate would be part of a major technology transformation team responsible for moving towards cloud platform using Java, Spring boot and Node.js, and will leverage working knowledge of platforms such as PCF and AWS. The individual will set engineering standards, perform code reviews, mentor developers, and partner with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and mentor a team of developers, fostering a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Perform regular code reviews to ensure code quality, security, maintainability, and alignment with architecture and engineering standards.
* Provide hands\-on development across the stack using Java Spring boot framework and Node.js (for backend), ReactJs (for frontend) including building APIs, Micro\-services, and UI components.
* Drive technical design discussions and guide implementation decisions (system design, integration patterns, performance, scalability, and reliability).
* Oversee delivery execution for the team: plan work, manage priorities, remove blockers, and ensure timely completion of commitments.
* Develop and maintain integrations with APIs, webhooks, authentication, and partner onboarding workflows.
* Collaborate closely with Product, UX, QA, and Operations across the SDLC—from requirements through release and post\-production support.
* Support production readiness and operational excellence: troubleshoot issues, lead root\-cause analysis, and implement preventive improvements.
* Promote and improve engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, coding standards, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate effectively with geographically distributed teams and ensure consistent implementation of shared standards and processes.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 4\+ years in software engineering and 2\+ years in a technical leadership/lead engineer role.
* 4\+ years of expertise in Java, Spring boot, Node JS and React JS, with proven ability to lead design and implementation for complex web applications.
* Solid experience with modern architecture patterns (REST APIs, event\-driven systems), and building mission\-critical services with high availability and performance.
* Experience with Micro\-Frontends (preferred) and front\-end architecture, including shared components, governance, and build/deploy strategies.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud\-native practices (preferred), including security, scalability, and cost\-aware design.
* Familiarity with Apigee or a similar API management platform is preferred but not required.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation, and DevOps practices; ability to influence release strategy and improve engineering productivity.
* Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL data stores, data modeling, and performance tuning.
* Strong understanding of SDLC (Agile), release management, and change/incident management; comfortable leading technical ceremonies (grooming, design reviews, retros).
* AI\-assisted development experience: practical use of tools such as GitHub Copilot/ChatGPT/enterprise LLMs to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews—while ensuring secure usage, code quality, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts/on\-call as needed to support production issues and critical releases.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Excellent verbal/written communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills; able to articulate technical trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts/on\-call as needed to support production issues and critical releases.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. title: Associate Manager Product Design (Design)
description:
**Associate Manager Product Design**
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced Associate Product Design Engineer. As an Associate Product Design Manager at Bitwarden, you will step into a leadership role that blends people management with hands\-on product design. You believe security products can be both protective and genuinely delightful to use — and you want to help a team of designers bring that vision to life. You’ll support, coach, and grow a small team of product designers while continuing to contribute to the craft yourself. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineering leads, and cross\-functional partners to shape the overall design direction across the Bitwarden platform.
   

  

 This is a rare opportunity for an experienced IC designer ready to take their first step into formal people management — without fully stepping away from the work they love.
   

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Manage, mentor, and grow a small team of product designers — running 1:1s, supporting career development, and fostering a culture of craft and collaboration
* Partner with product managers and engineering leads to set design priorities, align roadmaps, and advocate for the user experience across the Bitwarden platform
* Contribute directly to select initiatives — creating user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity mockups, and prototypes as needed
* Facilitate design critiques and review sessions, helping the team produce consistent, high\-quality, and accessible work
* Facilitate user research and testing practices — helping the team plan and execute feedback cycles that inform design decisions with evidence
* Drive cross\-functional alignment by clearly communicating design rationale to a diverse stakeholder audience, including leadership
* Identify and implement process improvements that increase design team effectiveness, quality, and velocity
* Uphold and evolve Bitwarden’s design system and standards across desktop, mobile (iOS \& Android), web, and browser extension


**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**
* 3–5 years of experience in product design, with at least some informal experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating the work of other designers
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong UI craft, systems thinking, and the ability to solve complex UX problems across platforms
* Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with other design and developer tools (e.g., Claude, Loveable, Replit, ChatGPT, V0, Adobe, GitHub)
* Experience planning and facilitating user research, testing sessions, and design critiques
* Ability to communicate design decisions with clarity — through sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and in conversation with stakeholders
* A collaborative and adaptable mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity and prioritizing across competing demands
* Strong verbal and written communication skills paired with openness and authenticity — you give and receive feedback well
* The desire to grow as a manager: you’re energized by helping others do their best work, not just doing it yourself
* Excitement and enthusiasm for open source software and better internet security


**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**
* Experience in a player\-coach or tech lead role on a design team
* Startup or fast\-growth company experience
* Familiarity with WCAG accessibility guidelines
* Experience designing for security\-focused applications
* Experience designing for both B2C and B2B customers
* Cross\-platform design experience (desktop, mobile, web, browser extension)
* Front\-end development experience or strong familiarity with engineering practices


**DESIGN AT BITWARDEN**
 The Product Design team at Bitwarden is dedicated to simplifying the management of sensitive data for users of all skill levels, with a focus on creating user\-friendly experiences that enhance efficiency and security. We aim to provide clear options and guide users toward best practices. Bitwarden’s design team strives to create experiences where everyone can manage their data with confidence, fostering trust through a consistent and transparent approach. With this intention, we aim to enhance user experiences by transforming routine tasks into enjoyable moments, ultimately making every interaction with our products delightful and empowering for our customers.
   

  

**WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS**
* Meeting with our Talent Acquisition Team
* Interview with Hiring Manager
* Interview with team members
* Portfolio review
* References


**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**
* The Bitwarden user community loves staying secure, and the feeling is mutual. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose and bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
* Become an expert. You’ll become immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open\-source software.
* Bitwarden remains dedicated to building a diverse and talented team.
* Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with your team’s support and join the Bitwarden \#growth\-club to continue your personal and professional development.

title: Scrum Master, AVP
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master
   

  

* We’re looking for an experienced Scrum Master to drive a culture of continuous improvement
* You’ll make sure that your team lives by the values of Scrum, empowering them to become high performing to increase the productivity, as well as frequency and quality of delivery
* Hone your project skills as you work with talented people in collaborative and innovative environment, with access to the bank's Agile community, experts and events
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 This role will see you coaching and guiding your team to perform at their highest level and at a sustainable pace. You’ll remove any impediments to progress, facilitate meetings, protect the team from outside influences or distractions and work with the product owner to make sure that the product backlog is in good shape and ready for the next sprint.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Making sure the Scrum team understands Agile practices, the Scrum framework and values, and that the team uses this framework to deliver working software to satisfy platform customers and react to their needs quickly
* Transforming the Scrum team to become self\-organising to reduce management overhead costs, using techniques such as Systems and Lean thinking
* Acting as the process owner for the team, and maintaining relationships with the project's key stakeholders
* Creating a great place to work with a culture of safety and continuous improvement, through great people leadership, coaching, engagement and development of skills


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 We're looking for someone with experience of successful Scrum adoption along with a Scrum Master certification. You'll need knowledge of modern development practices and tools, as well as a background in coaching cross\-functional teams into high performing teams.
   

  

 You’ll also need knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency, as well as experience of building a culture of transparency within feature teams by empowering individuals and inspiring a collaborative team performance.
   

  

**We'll Look To You To Demonstrate**
* Experience working as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
* Strong knowledge of Scrum, Agile frameworks, and SAFe practices.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams and complex technology initiatives
* Experience of automated testing frameworks

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team.  In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 11 to 13\+ years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps

* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers

**Desired Skills**

description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and 30,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection. Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



  





**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** 




 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
 



  





 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* 









*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.* 









*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud.* 




  





 The Scrum Master at Cvent (SM) facilitates processes, escalates impediments, manages risk, and helps to drive continuous improvement at the team level. The scrum master acts as a servant leader to the team and promotes scrum best practices and coaches the team to track and constantly improves its velocity. The Scrum Master is expected to handle 2\-3 Sprint teams as a Scrum Master.
 



  





**Position Duties** 



* Helps to establish sprint cadence.
* Coordinates with product owners to keep the sprint team’s backlog ready and groomed.
* Facilitates sprint planning, review, daily scrum, refinement meetings, and retrospective events at the team level.
* Publishes committed sprint objectives.
* Identifies and escalates impediments.
* Manage team or project level risks and issues and take corrective actions to mitigate them, develop mitigation strategies and support the teams in addressing challenges.
* Maintains relevant metrics to help the team monitor their performance.
* Coordinates elements of the sprint plan with other technology staff outside of the project.
* Take responsibility for managing dependencies within the sprint team as well as those dependencies from other development or operations teams.
* Participates as well as facilitate Scrum of Scrums.
* Encourages Architect, UX, QT and Sprint team collaboration.
* Coordinates timely response and support to production line customer issues and helps to ensure that team maintains adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Facilitate Project / Epic estimation process.
* Identify and promote opportunities for integrating AI tools and automation into team processes for improved efficiency (e.g., backlog refinement, reporting, estimation, or retrospective analysis).
* Documentation and Reporting: Maintain project documentation such as sprint plans, burndown charts, and crucial project documents like the Risk Register and Project Charter. Provide regular updates on project progress to stakeholders.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders regarding project progress and deliverables, ensuring they are informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.
* Actively encourage and guide the team in applying AI\-driven insights to optimize workflows, improve sprint predictability, and address bottlenecks.
* Communicates sprint/team or project status to stakeholders at a fixed cadence.
* Coordinate work teams consisting of R\&D / SRE / Cloud Operations / blended teams using agile methodologies.
* Promotes adherence to Agile software development best practices.
* Ensure team members have the necessary resources to complete their tasks.
* Ensure that sprint team deliverables meet the required quality standards.
* Drives continuous improvement initiatives at the team level.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to identify and resolve issues.
* Acts as an Agile coach to the development team.



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* 4\-7 years of technical experience including 2\-5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach.
* Understanding backlog tracking, burn down metrics, velocity, task definition, and other Agile terminology.
* Large/enterprise application development experience using Agile methodologies preferred but not required.
* Strong leadership, time management, conflict resolution, and analytical skills.
* Able to act as servant leader at the team level or project level.
* Situational Awareness \- Must be the first to notice differences and issues as they arise, make all necessary attempts to solve them before elevating them to management.
* Drive for continuous improvement.
* Quick learner \- Must be able to quickly gain high level understanding of the technical and business domains of the development team.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-powered productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., AI meeting assistants, reporting bots, AI Agents, Glean, backlog analyzers etc.) is a must have.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI\-driven solutions for workflow improvement.
* Self\-motivation and the ability to work under minimal supervision are a must.
* Outstanding written and oral communication.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and techniques will be an added advantage.
* Experience with Atlassian Tools such as Jira and Confluence preferred but not required.
* Experience and knowledge of PI planning will be an added advantage.
* Experience in project management will be an added advantage.

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 In a world where data is critical to BCG's success, we are building first\-class, foundational capabilities and products across the firm. Within this vision, LEAP is delivering BCG's new Learning platform to power the firm's learning and development needs.
   

  

 Initially, you’ll work within the Data Product squad to build a custom data product in Snowflake as part of a broader transformation program of BCG’s learning technology. The data product will help enable AI\-driven learning and make learning data accessible to other teams and systems, including, for example, staffing and analytics. When the program has ended, you’ll be part of a Learning squad with RtB as its scope.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop well\-structured Agile user stories and acceptance criteria that enable effective solution delivery, and owning your area of backlog
* Analyze processes and data needs, contributing to solution design and identifying practical approaches to business problems.
* Coordinate functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
* Support release readiness and implementation, identifying issues and working with technical teams to resolve them.
* Elicit, document, and validate requirements by engaging multiple stakeholder groups and subject matter experts.
* Write clear, well\-structured user stories and acceptance criteria understandable by both technical and functional colleagues.
* Create, update, and maintain requirements documentation (e.g., PRDs / functional specifications).
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, anticipating questions and translating technical details into plain language.
* Manage and triage support requests in a query management system (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Proactively flag risks and dependencies, keeping learner impact and business value as the priority.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

***Education***
* Bachelor's degree required.
* 5–8 years of experience as a business / systems analyst, ideally supporting or configuring enterprise applications.


**Experience / Knowledge**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5\-7 years of experience with Learning or HR applications.
* Experience with learning management or experience platforms; Docebo experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with data products, third\-party platforms, and SaaS technology solutions.
* Working technical fluency with Snowflake, querying databases, and querying APIs to understand and validate data.
* Strong Agile experience, including writing user stories and working with Jira, sprints, and ceremonies.
* Experience developing and executing functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The Business Analyst is a role within the Data Product Squad, part of LEAP in BCG's digital products organisation. Reporting to the IT Director, you will work day\-to\-day with your Product Owner, Chapter Leads, Scrum Master, and squad members, as well as functional business partners, subject matter experts, and IT colleagues. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to analyse, configure, and evolve BCG's new Learning platform, supporting both day\-to\-day operations and transformative change.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You're Good At**
* Translating learning and business needs into product requirements — asking the right questions and pushing past surface\-level answers.
* Writing clear, well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements documentation.
* Communicating clearly, both verbally and in writing, with all staff levels including leadership; excellent listening skills.
* Engaging and managing stakeholders across business, functional, and IT groups, and collaborating remotely with global experts.
* Being outcome\-focused — keeping learner impact and business value front of mind.
* Owning your workstream — taking responsibility for your area of the backlog and delivery, proactively flagging risks.
* Managing data definitions and basic governance — flagging when a decision has governance implications.
* Working within an Agile framework.
